name: earthquake-mcp-server
description: Search USGS and EMSC seismic data — real-time feeds, event queries, and earthquake counts via MCP. STDIO or Streamable HTTP.

USGS_BASE_URL.title: USGS Base URL
USGS_BASE_URL.description: USGS API base URL. Leave blank for https://earthquake.usgs.gov.

EMSC_BASE_URL.title: EMSC Base URL
EMSC_BASE_URL.description: EMSC API base URL. Leave blank for https://www.seismicportal.eu.

DEFAULT_LIMIT.title: Default search limit
DEFAULT_LIMIT.description: Events earthquake_search_events returns when a call omits limit (1-1000). Leave blank for 15.

REQUEST_TIMEOUT_MS.title: Request timeout (ms)
REQUEST_TIMEOUT_MS.description: Per-attempt HTTP timeout in milliseconds (1000-120000). Feed, search, and event calls also share a 50-second total deadline across every request and retry; standalone count calls use this per-attempt value. Leave blank for 10000.

EARTHQUAKE_CLAMP_LIMITS.title: Clamp limits
EARTHQUAKE_CLAMP_LIMITS.description: Clamp a search or feed limit above 1000 to 1000 with a notice. Set false to advertise and enforce a maximum of 1000 instead. Leave blank for true.
